parameter_interpretation.floor_centerline_xyz_m: Local support/floor reference; each branch retains its own z.
parameter_interpretation.cross_section: Asymmetric rounded void with offset arch and roof indentation; procedural, not digitized from Figure A6.
parameter_interpretation.width_m: Nominal main-section maximum 26 m is inspired by the reported estimate, not a lower clearance bound. Junction unions can be wider.
parameter_interpretation.height_m: Nominal main-section floor-to-roof upper envelope 16 m; roof indentation reduces it locally.
parameter_interpretation.depth: Main roof placed roughly near -130 m as a visualization assumption; the paper does not establish this exact floor or roof datum.
parameter_interpretation.roughness: No fabricated sub-metre measured lunar surface detail.
parameter_interpretation.roof_sag_m: Authored visual-shape hypothesis: main 2.4 m, rejoining branch 1.6 m, lower branch 1.2 m; not measured by the cited radar study.
parameter_interpretation.topology: All longitudinal coordinates, lengths, turns, branch locations and level spacings are assumptions.
parameter_interpretation.end_caps: Artificial finite-domain closures; do not imply observed geological dead ends.
parameter_interpretation.entry: No observed skylight is assigned; the underground model has no surface entry.
parameter_interpretation.stability: No geomechanical solution or structural safety certification.
parameter_interpretation.probability: Candidates are unweighted hypotheses; no inferred posterior probabilities.
